home.seo_title: Fremio - Online Photo Booth & Virtual Photobox
home.seo_description: Fremio is the best online photo booth & virtual photobox. Take photos via camera, choose from hundreds of cool frames, add stickers & effects, then download for free!
home.hero_sub: Fremio is your go-to companion for celebrating memories. Anytime and anywhere, you can be whoever you want to be.
home.story_p1: One day you'll look back and realize it wasn't the big moments that mattered most, but the everyday moments that seemed ordinary—family laughter, friends' jokes, a loved one's gentle gaze.
home.story_p2: One day home will feel quiet. Your favorite place will feel bland. What matters most is: were you truly present when all of that happened?
home.vision_text: Everyone has a story worth celebrating. Fremio is here as a companion in every unique story that unfolds every day.
home.mission_text: Providing the right frame for your story every month—so that small moments feel special.

pricing.subtitle_p2: Fremio is here to give those moments space to be expressed, felt, and remembered.
pricing.subtitle_p4: It's about how we give meaning to our life's story.

pricing.payment_safe_desc: Your transactions are protected by Midtrans, Indonesia's trusted payment gateway
pricing.faq_1_a: There are 3 options: 3 days (Rp 6,000), 2 weeks / 14 days (Rp 15,000), and 1 month / 30 days (Rp 25,000). Choose the one that fits your needs before proceeding to payment.
pricing.faq_2_q: What do I get as a member?
pricing.faq_2_a: Unlimited access to all Fremio frame collections, including new frames released every month and special series (Holiday, Year-End, etc.).
pricing.faq_3_q: Can I renew my membership before 30 days is up?
pricing.faq_3_a: Currently, renewal can only be done after the active period has ended. We will remind you as your expiry date approaches.
pricing.faq_4_a: Premium frames will be locked again. You'll need to renew your membership to regain access to the full collection.
pricing.faq_5_a: Click "Join as a Fremio Member", choose your preferred payment method (Credit/Debit Card, Bank Transfer, E-Wallet, or Convenience Store), and follow the payment instructions from Midtrans.
